report.summary: Reviewed chunk 4 of daedalus/council/vendors.py: AntigravityAdapter, OllamaAdapter, VendorAvailability, available_vendors; claims mostly kept, one uncheckable.
risks: AntigravityAdapter._dispatch | medium | 'not_on_path' check relies on result.spawn_error prefix, but error format from run_managed is not pinned in this chunk; if prefix changes, status misreported. | Inspect run_managed's spawn_error contract.
OllamaAdapter._dispatch | medium | ProviderHTTPError message matching ('timed out', 'cannot reach') is fragile; error text format not pinned here. | Inspect ProviderHTTPError implementation.

available_vendors | low | ollama availability probe uses http_probe with path='/api/version', but no verification that response body indicates success; false positives possible. | Check server_reachable implementation.

handoff.purpose: Review AntigravityAdapter, OllamaAdapter, VendorAvailability, and available_vendors for consistency with docstring claims.

symbols.name: AntigravityAdapter
symbols.note: Adapter for Google agy over ssh; disabled by default unless signed_in=True.

symbols.name: AntigravityAdapter.__init__
symbols.note: Sets default lane='untrusted', stores ssh_target, effort, signed_in, ssh_command, runner; endpoint derived from ssh_target.

symbols.name: AntigravityAdapter.argv
symbols.note: Builds ssh argv with -T, BatchMode=yes, ConnectTimeout=5, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; runs 'agy -p -' with prompt on stdin; includes --model if model is not unknown.

symbols.name: AntigravityAdapter._dispatch
symbols.note: Dispatches via runner with stdin text; handles spawn errors, timeouts, auth, connect, not_on_path, nonzero exit, JSON parsing; returns status dict.

symbols.name: OllamaAdapter
symbols.note: Adapter for local/bench Ollama over /api/chat; refuses over-budget prompts; lane defaults to trusted.

symbols.name: OllamaAdapter.__init__
symbols.note: Sets host, output_reserve, chat, endpoint; computes local via lane_for_host(host)=='trusted'.

symbols.name: OllamaAdapter.independence_class
symbols.note: Returns ('local', model_family(self.model)), deliberately not keyed on host.

symbols.name: OllamaAdapter._dispatch
symbols.note: Checks token budget, calls native_chat, handles ProviderHTTPError and TimeoutError/OSError; returns status dict.

symbols.name: VendorAvailability
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass describing availability probe result without invoking a model.

symbols.name: available_vendors
symbols.note: Cheap probe to determine available vendors: checks CLI paths, ssh presence, agy sign-in flag, and Ollama host reachability.

claims.text: Google/Antigravity ``agy`` on the RTX bench, over ssh.
claims.why: The class uses ssh_command and ssh_target, and the argv constructs an ssh invocation.

claims.text: The prompt goes on STDIN (``agy -p -``) and NEVER on a command line.
ssh with a trailing command does not take an argv: it concatenates its arguments and hands the string to the REMOTE login shell, which re-parses it.
claims.why: The adapter uses ssh with a trailing command ('agy ...') and passes the prompt via stdin, consistent with the claim.

claims.text: Local subprocess argv quoting cannot help: the escaping that matters belongs to a shell we cannot see.
claims.why: The prompt is never placed in argv; it is sent via stdin, so local quoting is irrelevant.

claims.text: agy has not completed its one-time interactive sign-in on this machine, so this adapter is DISABLED BY DEFAULT: it reports unavailable / not_authenticated immediately rather than hanging on an auth prompt.
claims.why: signed_in defaults to False; _dispatch returns status='unavailable' reason='not_authenticated' when signed_in is False.

claims.text: An operator asserts sign-in with signed_in=True; nothing here probes it, because probing means invoking a model.
claims.why: The adapter only checks the signed_in flag; it never attempts a probe call.

claims.text: Local or bench Ollama over the native /api/chat contract.
claims.why: _dispatch calls self._chat with messages, which is native_chat by default; the endpoint is the host.

claims.text: The host is passed EXPLICITLY per call. OLLAMA_HOST is never read for routing and never written
claims.why: This chunk does not show OLLAMA_HOST being read or written; it only shows host passed explicitly to _chat.

claims.text: local is sensitivity.lane_for_host(host) == 'trusted' -- numeric loopback only, the same predicate that decides the egress lane, so the two cannot disagree about one host.
claims.why: self.local = lane_for_host(self.host) == 'trusted' is computed directly in __init__.

claims.text: Over-budget prompts are REFUSED LOUDLY. Ollama HEAD-truncates an over-long prompt -- it eats the system prompt first -- so a silently truncated council turn is a reviewer that never saw the question it is answering.
claims.why: _dispatch checks tokens > window and returns status='error' reason='over_context_budget' with a detailed stderr message.

claims.text: The budget is _ollama_native.effective_input_window() (full num_ctx minus the generation reserve), reused rather than reinvented.
claims.why: _dispatch calls effective_input_window() (with reserve if provided) and num_ctx_value() in the error message.

claims.text: Cheap probe result. No model is invoked to produce this.
claims.why: The dataclass only holds data; available_vendors uses which() and http_probe() only, no model calls.

claims.text: Which vendors could be seated, established by CHEAP PROBES ONLY. Does the binary exist; does the Ollama host answer /api/version. No model is invoked, no prompt is sent, nothing is billed.
claims.why: The function uses shutil.which for claude, codex, ssh; and http_probe for Ollama /api/version. No model calls.

claims.text: agy is reported unavailable until an operator asserts sign-in: the only way to test its auth is to call it, and a probe that calls a model is not a probe.
claims.why: agy availability is determined by ssh_path and agy_signed_in flag; if not signed in, reason='not_authenticated'.

claims.text: Both callables are injectable so a test can establish availability with no CLI on PATH and no network.
claims.why: which and http_probe are parameters with defaults, allowing injection.

observations.what: AntigravityAdapter._dispatch checks result.spawn_error.startswith('not_on_path') to decide reason, but the format of spawn_error is not pinned in this chunk.
OllamaAdapter._dispatch matches ProviderHTTPError message substrings 'timed out' and 'cannot reach' to decide status; error text format is not pinned here.

available_vendors probes Ollama via http_probe with path='/api/version' but does not verify response content; a non-200 response might still be considered reachable depending on server_reachable implementation.
